# Project: Mini Uniswap Token Swap Form
This is a React Vite project with Tailwind CSS for building a modern token swap interface similar to Uniswap.

## Technologies
- React 18
- Vite
- Tailwind CSS
- TypeScript

## Features
- Token selection with images
- Amount input with validation
- Exchange rate calculation
- Loading states
- Modern UI with glassmorphism effects
